_doc: Arenas: each match draws one whose painted board is installed (never the previous one). All boards share the socket layout of scenes/arenas/standard.tscn (docs/ARENA_BRIEF.md). board/mist/frame are under assets/arenas/, props under assets/arenas/props/<id>_<name>.png; tools/arena/import_arena.py fetches them. divider.kind: river | stream | wind | embers | frost. ambient: embers | embers_hot | motes | dust | snow. Prop fields are documented in scripts/battle/arena_props.gd.

arenas.name: The Shore of the Acheron
arenas.intro: Past the gate, the souls who never chose crowd the riverbank. Charon will not ferry the living.
arenas.art: wide panoramic view of the dark shore of the river Acheron in Hell, endless crowd of pale naked souls waiting on the rocky bank on the left and right, a wide calm black river across the middle of the image, the ancient ferryman Charon in a small boat with a glowing lantern far away on the water, distant cliffs under a starless sky with a faint red glow

arenas.name: The Noble Castle
arenas.intro: The good who never knew faith walk this green meadow forever. Nothing hurts here; they only long.
arenas.art: game board seen from above: grey-green meadow of Limbo, the seven walls of the Noble Castle at the top edge, a thin clear stream across the middle, carved stone frame and sockets as in the Acheron layout

arenas.name: The Cliffs of the Whirlwind
arenas.intro: A storm that never rests drives the lovers round and round. Keep your footing.
arenas.art: game board seen from above: wind-beaten cliffs of the second circle, pale souls whirling in the storm at the left and right edges, a current of wind and mist across the middle, carved stone frame and sockets as in the Acheron layout

arenas.name: The City of Dis
arenas.intro: Behind red-hot iron walls, the heretics lie in open tombs of fire. The Furies are watching.
arenas.art: game board seen from above: inside the City of Dis, open burning tombs along the left and right edges, red-hot iron walls at the top, a glowing crack full of embers across the middle, carved stone frame and sockets as in the Acheron layout

arenas.name: The Frozen Lake
arenas.intro: At the bottom of Hell nothing burns. Traitors lie locked in the ice, and the wind of Lucifer's wings never stops.
arenas.art: game board seen from above: the frozen lake of Cocytus, sinners locked in the ice at the left and right edges, Lucifer's huge bat wings far away at the top, a crack in the ice across the middle, carved stone frame and sockets as in the Acheron layout
